gloss: Progress that also sharpens the signs that going further in the same direction would do harm
mechanism: Each step of progress in a direction also records what it revealed about that direction's limits: an observable sign that further steps would do harm, kept as a {{risk}} trigger. A direction counts as brakegrow progress only while each step adds or sharpens such a sign, and it is reviewed when any recorded sign appears.
invariants: Each step adds a harm sign for the direction or sharpens an existing one.
Every recorded sign is observable during the work.
When a recorded sign appears, the direction is reviewed before the next step.
failure_modes: Momentum blindness: steps continue while no harm sign is recorded.
Alarm inflation: vague signs are recorded that could never fire.
